But while many employees can only dream of a Saturday off, schools across the country are giving students a reprieve from the Monday morning blues with three-day weekends. More than 2,100 schools in more than 850 districts across 26 states have made the switch to a four-day week, according to researchers at Oregon State University. Mo
ents: The four-day workweek has yet to go mainstream
